title: DigiBlock
tagline: Soulbound token Dapp to hold our on chain resume. Share your wallet address to share your resume.
description:
DigiBlock is worlds #1 Soulbound Token based DApp. Get NFTs for your work experience, courses taken and even earn tokens to get heavy discounts on your next course.
Just share your wallet address to share your overall resume with empolyers in one click.

To make ERC721 soulbound we have overrides the transfer events . 
We have also tokenized the learning by allowing instructors to award tokens to students which can be used to get some discounts on future courses. These token transfer functions have overrides such that only they can be used to buy courses. It's non-transferable to another user.
how_its_made:
We have deployed our contracts on the FEVM contract. Its EVM compatibility enables us to deploy our Soulbound token pretty easily on the Wallaby testnet. 

To make ERC721 soulbound we have overrides the transfer events . 
We have also tokenized the learning by allowing instructors to award tokens to students which can be used to get some discounts on future courses. These token transfer functions have overrides such that only they can be used to buy courses. It's non-transferable to another user.

We have used Reactjs for frontend and Hardhat for the contract development.
